about: The skeleton key and the grating, from below: locked with a skull-and-crossbones lock, unlocked with the key and nothing else, opened to the trees with the leaves falling through, the Grating Room lit by the day while it is open and dark when it is shut; and from above, in the Clearing, open and shut but never unlocked or locked, and the way down through it.

expect.words: West of House
You are standing in an open field west of a white house, with a boarded front door.
There is a small mailbox here.
North of House
You are facing the north side of a white house. There is no door here, and all the windows are boarded up. To the north a narrow path winds through the trees.
Behind House
You are behind the white house. A path leads into the forest to the east. In one corner of the house there is a small window which is slightly ajar.
With great effort, you open the window far enough to allow entry.
Kitchen

You are in the kitchen of the white house. A table seems to have been used recently for the preparation of food. A passage leads to the west and a dark staircase can be seen leading upward. A dark chimney leads down and to the east is a small window which is open.
On the table is an elongated brown sack, smelling of hot peppers.
A bottle is sitting on the table.
The glass bottle contains:
A quantity of water
Living Room

You are in the living room. There is a doorway to the east, a wooden door with strange gothic lettering to the west, which appears to be nailed shut, a trophy case, and a large oriental rug in the center of the room.
A battery-powered brass lantern is on the trophy case.
Above the trophy case hangs an elvish sword of great antiquity.
Taken.
Taken.
With a great effort, the rug is moved to one side of the room, revealing the dusty cover of a closed trap door.
The door reluctantly opens to reveal a rickety staircase descending into darkness.
The brass lantern is now on.
The trap door crashes shut, and you hear someone barring it.
Cellar
You are in a dark and damp cellar with a narrow passageway leading north, and a crawlway to the south. On the west is the bottom of a steep metal ramp which is unclimbable.
Your sword is glowing with a faint blue glow.
The Troll Room
This is a small room with passages to the east and south and a forbidding hole leading west. Bloodstains and deep scratches (perhaps made by an axe) mar the walls.
A nasty-looking troll, brandishing a bloody axe, blocks all passages out of the room.
Your sword has begun to glow very brightly.
(with the sword)
It's curtains for the troll as your sword removes his head.
Almost as soon as the troll breathes his last breath, a cloud of sinister black fog envelops him, and when the fog lifts, the carcass has disappeared.
Your sword is no longer glowing.

The deceased adventurer's useless lantern is here.
Beside the skeleton is a rusty knife.
There is a skeleton key here.
An old leather bag, bulging with coins, is here.
Taken.

Grating Room
You are in a small room near the maze. There are twisty passages in the immediate vicinity.
Above you is a grating locked with a skull-and-crossbones lock.
The grating is set into the roof of the room, heavy iron bars rusted the colour of old leaves. It is closed, and fastened with a skull-and-crossbones lock.

The lock on the underside of the grating is a heavy iron thing with a skull and crossbones cast into its face, which seems excessive for a grating. It has a keyhole of generous size, as though whoever made it expected a key of some character.
The grating is closed.
The grating is locked.
Can you unlock a grating with a sword?
The grate is unlocked.
The grating opens to reveal trees above you.
A pile of leaves falls onto your head and to the ground.
Grating Room
You are in a small room near the maze. There are twisty passages in the immediate vicinity.
Above you is an open grating with sunlight pouring in.
On the ground is a pile of leaves.
Sunlight pours down through the open grating, green from the leaves of the trees above. After the maze it is almost indecently cheerful.
It is a pile of dead leaves, brown and damp, of the sort a forest produces without being asked. It is rather deeper than leaves usually lie, as though someone had swept them together on purpose.
The brass lantern is now off.

It is pitch black. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
You can't see any such thing.

Clearing
You are in a clearing, with a forest surrounding you on all sides. A path leads south.
There is an open grating, descending into darkness.
It is a heavy iron grating, set securely into the ground and rusted to the colour of the leaves that hid it. Below it is only darkness.
The grating is open.
The grating is closed.

There is a grating securely fastened into the ground.
The grating is closed!
You can't reach the lock from here.
You can't lock it from this side.
The grating opens.
